description: This file defines the VideoService class, which encapsulates business logic for listing and searching videos. It interacts with the VideoRepository to retrieve video data from the database.

classes.name: VideoService
classes.description: Provides business logic methods for video listing and search operations, including retrieving individual videos and performing search queries with pagination.

methods.name: None __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the VideoService with a database session and instantiates the VideoRepository.

methods.name: Video|None get(self, video_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a Video by its ID, returns None if not found.

methods.name: tuple[list[Video],int] search(self, q: str | None, tag: str | None, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Performs a search for videos based on query string, tag, with pagination parameters limit and offset. Ensures limit is between 1 and 100, and offset is non-negative.
